more_info.overview: Tara gum is used as a stabilizer in food. Its technological role is to help maintain the structure of food.
more_info.origin: Made by grinding the seed endosperm of the tara plant. The principal material is a galactomannan polysaccharide.
more_info.dietary_restrictions: The specified starting material is plant derived and compatible with vegetarian and vegan diets. The specification does not establish halal or kosher certification.
more_info.side_effects:
EFSA found no concern for assessed food uses.
Animal studies found no adverse effects at the highest tested doses.
